shared_context.topic: flu test same as influenza test

atoms.1: A 'flu test' and an 'influenza test' refer to the same diagnostic procedure.
atoms.2: Both 'flu test' and 'influenza test' are terms used interchangeably.
atoms.3: A 'flu test' detects the presence of influenza viruses.
atoms.4: An 'influenza test' detects the presence of influenza viruses.
atoms.5: These tests detect influenza viruses in patients exhibiting influenza-like illness symptoms.
atoms.6: Influenza tests are often referred to as rapid influenza diagnostic tests (RIDTs).
atoms.7: Influenza tests are also referred to as rapid antigen tests.
atoms.8: Influenza tests are also referred to as molecular assays.
atoms.9: Influenza tests are designed to identify influenza A viral infections.
atoms.10: Influenza tests are designed to identify influenza B viral infections.
atoms.11: Influenza tests are crucial for prompt diagnosis.
atoms.12: Influenza tests are crucial for appropriate management of the illness.
atoms.13: Influenza tests are especially important during the influenza season.

snippets.output: A “flu test” and an “influenza test” refer to the same diagnostic procedure; the terms are used interchangeably.
A “flu test” and an “influenza test” both detect the presence of influenza viruses in patients exhibiting influenza-like illness symptoms.
Influenza tests are often referred to as rapid influenza diagnostic tests (RIDTs).
Influenza tests are also referred to as rapid antigen tests and molecular assays.
Influenza tests are designed to identify influenza A and influenza B viral infections.
Influenza tests are crucial for prompt diagnosis and appropriate management of influenza-like illness.
Influenza tests are especially important during the influenza season.
